title: Who Says Yes, and When Does It Matter?
author: Dany Sigha
description: Statistical analysis of a Portuguese bank's direct marketing campaigns. Uses Mann-Whitney U, Spearman correlation, Kruskal-Wallis H, and Chi-Square tests to identify when campaigns succeed and why 88% of calls fail to convert. Includes interactive 3D scatter, dual-axis temporal charts, and campaign fatigue analysis.
